review_text: "JAS Cafainated in Bajada is a cozy and inviting café that's perfect for coffee breaks, casual meet-ups, or even getting some work done in a relaxed setting. The ambiance is warm and comfortable, creating a peaceful space where you can truly enjoy your time. Their drinks are flavorful, well-crafted, and served with quality that coffee lovers will appreciate. The staff are friendly, attentive, and accommodating, making every visit pleasant and welcoming. If you're around Bajada, Davao City, this is definitely a highly recommended spot for great coffee, good vibes, and excellent service."

Opens at 6 a.m. Long menu to pore over with justifiable prices. Tried their Danggit (generously portioned) with egg and Strawberry lemonade for breakfast. Took home their viands to share (3 people) all were good. Surprised with the Creme brulee cake as it was immersed in a milky sweet liquid that seemed like 'condensada'. Place was huge enough for small group meetings. Seemed like there's a second floor too. Staff service was okay. Wifi connection was readily available. Only problem was the restricted parking space.

#reysrestaurantreview J.A.S Caffeinated There are so many things to like about Caffeinated. a. The location is perfect. Accessible but not congested. b. Interior is not spectacular but not disgusting. Boring yes (God, plastic plants must be outlawed now). Plastic Plants are simply a sign of poverty of imagination. Gray walls with soft yellow hanging lights ? Really? But it will do. c. Service is good. Although the four staff have the tendency to conglomerate in the pantry and you need to shout to call their attention , but they are smiling and efficient except one whose default mode is frowning. No problem. Baka may MPD (may prosesong dinadaanan) d. Food is great and affordable. I tried four menus: grilled salmon is glorious, seafood marinara is okay, JAS Salad is fine, and sausage platter is a No NO. Don't order it. And three pieces of sausage is not a Platter. Go to Swiss Deli, they know what is Sausage Platter. My only beef? Their insistence that caramelized cheese cake is Creme Brulee. Excuse me. Those who know me are aware that there are only three desserts I can tolerate: banoffee is third, blueberry cheesecake is second and creme brulee is first. I have tasted creme brulee in a Parisienne deli, in Venice and all over the country. I KNOW what is creme brûlée.So don't me. Still, this is a great cafe, so I really recommend this when you are in Davao.

We got here past 9pm and wanted something light. We ordered a hot matcha latte and an iced caramel macchiato and paired them with a creme brulee cake. I found the matcha too sweet for my taste. I requested more matcha and I was graciously accommodated. However, it was still too sweet. I prefer mine with the right balance of matcha flavor with a bit of sweetness. The caramel macchiato paired well with the cake according to my friend. The creme brulee cake seems like a bestseller since there were only two slices left. Its cream filling complemented with the caramel topping and the chiffon was spongy and light. They offer free wifi, you just need to ask for the password since the network signal for mobile data is weak.

A locally owned coffee shop and cafe. I got an iced mocha. It was very good and reasonably priced. For a snack I got the BBQ fries. I was expecting it to be like Parmesan fries but with BBQ flavoring. It was literally fries with a side of BBQ sauce. The sauce was good and the fries were crisp. They also include a glass of water free of charge unlike other coffee shops where you have to buy bottled water which is nice. The waitress was preoccupied with her phone when I walked in, I walked up to counter and asked whether I order at counter or table. She handed me a menu and I ordered at the counter. Once I placed the order she was friendly and prompt. The drink and fries were served within 3 minutes of ordering. An older lady was taking care of another table and did a good job. Atmosphere is clean, quiet and homey. Music is light upbeat jazz. AC is very good and so is the WiFi. The bathroom is clean and has TP, unlike most other establishments. Worth the walk from SM Lanang.
